_about: The stir task on the office table: what the twin puts on the table (learning/stir/twin.py writes sim/layouts/stir_office.json from it).
Units: metres, kg, degrees. Frame: the arm base frame (+y = arm forward, +x = arm's right), so the same xy is the same arm pose on every table.
Sizes are a common ceramic mug and a teaspoon-sized stirring spoon (the brief: mug ~8 cm across, 9-10 cm tall; spoon 15-20 cm). Tape-measure the real ones before REAL_RUN.md and edit here.
cup.inner_radius / height / wall: open cylinder, body origin at its centre (sim/build_scene.shape_parts 'cup').

spoon: flat handle (length, width across the jaws, thickness) + an ellipsoid bowl (full width, depth, length) at its lower end. Total length = handle_length + bowl[2] - 0.004 (the bowl overlaps the handle by 4 mm).
_rest_pose_about: The arm starts folded up and back (the rest pose of the r4 stir scene sim/layout_stir.json). The office layout's rest pose is the real arm's pose during the calibration frames, reaching forward over the table: its forearm lies across the cup at 19 cm and pushed the spoon off the rim. REAL_RUN.md: move the real arm to this pose before placing the mug.

cup.name: cup
cup._xy_about: 19 cm in front of the arm base, on its centre line: where the home bottle and home stir demo stood (0.18-0.20 m), inside the office reach map (sites/office/reach.json reaches every 10 deg ray at 0.18-0.22 m with the jaws <= 35 deg from vertical).
cup._liquid_about: fill level as a fraction of the height: 5.7 cm of drink, the bowl must be below it to stir anything
cup._randomize_about: operator_reset_scene(randomize=True) and the validation runs: +-3 cm sideways, 17-21 cm forward (the spoon follows, handle towards the base)

spoon.name: spoon
spoon._rest_about: Placed leaning on the rim on the side facing the arm base (the only side the arm holds a tilted tool from), bowl on the bottom against the far wall; twin.py drops it there and lets it settle for settle_s before writing its pose.

cameras.name: stir_cam
cameras._about: side view of the mug for the human side (docs images); the agent never gets it
